rows.note: Use this for prices or a market recovering after a fall.

example.english: After falling for several days, the market finally began to rally today.
example.traditional: 股市跌咗幾日，今日終於反彈。
example.jyutping: gu2 si5 dit3 zo2 gei2 jat6 gam1 jat6 zung1 jyu1 faan2 daan6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a public campaign or protest gathering.

example.english: Many citizens came to this rally to support environmental protection.
example.traditional: 今次集會有好多市民嚟支持環保。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 zaap6 wui2 jau5 hou2 do1 si5 man4 lai4 zi1 ci4 waan4 bou2

rows.note: Use this for one sequence of play between a serve and the winning shot.

example.english: This rally lasted a long time, and I won in the end.
example.traditional: 呢個回合打咗好耐，最後係我贏咗。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 wui4 hap6 daa2 zo2 hou2 noi6 zeoi3 hau6 hai6 ngo5 jeng4 zo2

rows.note: Use this as the general choice for regaining health, strength, or consciousness.

example.english: After surgery, Mom slowly began to rally and regain her strength.
example.traditional: 媽媽做完手術後，慢慢恢復體力。
example.jyutping: maa4 maa1 zou6 jyun4 sau2 seot6 hau6 maan6 maan6 fui1 fuk6 tai2 lik6

rows.note: Use this when prices or a market recover after falling.

example.english: After falling for several days, the stock market finally had a rally today.
example.traditional: 股市跌咗幾日之後，今日終於出現反彈。
example.jyutping: gu2 si5 dit3 zo2 gei2 jat6 zi1 hau6 gam1 jat6 zung1 jyu1 ceot1 jin6 faan2 daan6

rows.note: Use this when dispersed or defeated troops regroup and restore order.

example.english: After being scattered, the troops had to rally before setting out again.
example.traditional: 部隊被打散後，喺山邊重整旗鼓，再次出發。
example.jyutping: bou6 deoi2 bei6 daa2 saan2 hau6 hai2 saan1 bin1 cung4 zing2 kei4 gu2 zoi3 ci3 ceot1 faat3
